producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: A name-blind one-shot rule compiled from the three-cell taxonomy is not a complete agent decision procedure. Empirical gold is menu-relative representability. Unused symmetry (pair_eq on q_id) is leftover-looking and not quotientable on the registered menu. If every held-out row matches, surgery_holds. A miss is surgery_killed. Either verdict passes CI.
decision: Accept surgery_holds only if the signature rule matches empirical gold on every held-out row. Construction rows are disclosed authoring toys and cannot save a miss. A surgery_killed verdict is a valid passing run.

gates.SUR_ENUMERATION: At least four construction rows and four held-out rows.
gates.SUR_MENU: The repair menu has at least three screens.
gates.SUR_NAME_BLIND: The policy input is only Signature: mixes, n_fibres, n_worlds, y_has_nontrivial_symmetry, connection_mismatch.
gates.SUR_HELD_OUT_CONNECTION: The held-out affine cycle mismatches Kirchhoff.
gates.SUR_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: No text nomination, no LLM eval, no Paper F.

kill_criteria.SUR_ENUMERATION: Kill the instrument if the suite is too small.
kill_criteria.SUR_MENU: Kill the instrument if the menu is empty.
kill_criteria.SUR_GOLD_DEFINED: Kill the instrument if a case has no empirical repair.
kill_criteria.SUR_NAME_BLIND: Kill the instrument if the policy reads task or model names.
kill_criteria.SUR_HELD_OUT_CONNECTION: Kill the instrument if the held-out cycle is secretly Kirchhoff.
kill_criteria.SUR_RANKING_RECORDED: Kill the instrument if the verdict is missing.
kill_criteria.SUR_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: Kill the instrument if it claims an LLM result or a universal calculus.
kill_criteria.one_shot_rule: Kill the taxonomy-as-agent-rule claim if any held-out gold disagrees with decide(signature).

audit_card.target_object: Name-blind one-shot mapping from an obstruction signature to a menu action {restore, quotient, transport, noop}.
audit_card.decision: Accept or reject: the three-cell taxonomy is a complete cheap agent rule on this harness. Gold is empirical, not the cell we intended.
audit_card.representation: Paper A {0,1}^4 screens plus Aff(1, Z/3) 4-cycles. Features are mixes / fibre count / unused-or-used symmetry / Kirchhoff mismatch.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Finite enumeration. No sampling. No LLM.
material_assumptions: The policy may not try the menu and may not read English names.
Gold is: transport if Kirchhoff mismatches; else restore if a finer menu screen represents; else quotient if a coarser menu screen represents; else noop.
Construction rows are the authoring toys and are not the kill.
pair_eq + q_id is unused symmetry: some g leaves Y invariant, but no cheaper registered screen represents.
A miss does not reopen Paper B. Typed repairs can still work when tried.

objects.Signature: tuple of (mixes, n_fibres, n_worlds, y_has_nontrivial_symmetry, connection_mismatch)

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Worlds are {0,1}^4. Fibre counts are dimensionless integers. Actions are a four-element discrete set. Holonomy is Aff(1, Z/3).
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: There exists a held-out case whose empirical gold differs from decide(signature), or there does not. The instrument records which.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the registered 11 cases. Existential for a grain miss if one occurs.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Menu is {q_id, q_rot, q_perm, q_stab0, q_stab_last}. Connection gold ignores the PE screen. No sampling.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: Every case must have a defined gold or the instrument is empty.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Paper A representability. Paper B swap cell. Paper C Kirchhoff mismatch. Not a new group-theory theorem.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Task and screen names are labels; decide is forbidden to read them. Relabeling last_bit for first_bit is a disclosed held-out check, not a new ontology.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: If the held-out affine cycle matches Kirchhoff, the instrument is broken. If pair_eq + q_id becomes quotientable because a later menu screen is added, the grain miss can disappear; that is a menu change, not a rescue of the cheap rule on this menu.

compute.sampling: Finite {0,1}^4 enumeration and four-edge Aff(1, Z/3) cycles. No sampling.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as: on this harness, the cheap taxonomy signature is not a complete one-shot agent rule. Not text nomination. Not an LLM result. Not Paper F. Not a better LLM. Paper B is not reopened.
